license: GPL-3.0-only (new code of this skill, same as the existing Unity modules)
origin: Independent Python implementation of the UnityFS archive, serialized-file (v17-v22) and TypeTree layouts. Field order, flag meanings and the built-in TypeTree string table were cross-checked against the public format descriptions listed below and against real files read locally in read-only mode. No upstream source lines were copied.

symbols: files.SerializedFile (header, SerializedType, object table, externals, ref types)
references.use: Layout facts: UnityFS flag bits (0x40 combined, 0x80 info at end, 0x200 padding at start and the engine-version gate that separates it from an older vendor encryption flag), v7 16-byte header alignment, v22 64-bit header fields, v19 32-byte TypeTree nodes, v21 type dependencies and ref-type names, aligned 64-bit PathIDs.
Second description of the same layouts used to confirm field order and the common string offsets.
Pure-Python block decoder written from the format description; LZ4HC uses the same block format.
Already registered in the catalog; consulted only as another confirmation of the UnityFS node table.

deviations: Every count, length, decompressed size and read is bounded; unknown versions, flags, block or node flags, big-endian files, LZHAM and ManagedReferencesRegistry are rejected instead of guessed.

The bundle writer emits a single stored block with the streamed flag and stored blocks info; it keeps node order, paths, flags, version strings, blocks-info placement and 0x200 alignment, and refuses to change content when the blocks-info hash is nonzero.
TextAsset replacement only rewrites m_Script; every other object and node is compared byte for byte after rereading.
Runtime loading of rebuilt bundles has not been verified in any game.
